title: Titan Pro 15K Tobacco Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Tobacco offers a classic, well-rounded flavour that captures the familiar taste of traditional Tobacco without heaviness. Each puff delivers a smooth, balanced vape suited to everyday use. The Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container designed for the Titan Pro 15K device. Mesh-coil precision and the auto-feed refill system maintain clarity and consistency throughout use. Discover other great-tasting Titan Pro 15K refill pods and expand your collection with more Titan Pro refill flavours. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
